obligations.expected_behavior: Quick Dev operates in recommendation-only mode and emits recommendations without performing execution or lifecycle mutation.
forbidden_result: Quick Dev performs actions beyond producing recommendations.
obligations.state_after: Recommendation-only processing completes without execution or lifecycle mutation.
obligations.state_before: Quick Dev recommendation-only processing is invoked.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev recommendation mode
obligations.trigger: When Quick Dev recommendation-only processing is invoked.

obligations.expected_behavior: Read the explicit current snapshot before producing recommendations.
forbidden_result: Recommendations are produced without reading the explicit current snapshot.
A non-current or unspecified snapshot is used as the basis.
obligations.observable_result: The explicit current snapshot is read and available to recommendation processing.
obligations.state_after: Recommendation processing has consumed the explicit current snapshot.
obligations.state_before: An explicit current snapshot exists or is supplied for the invoked recommendation-only operation.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev snapshot reader
obligations.trigger: When Quick Dev recommendation-only processing begins.

obligations.expected_behavior: Distinguish observations that remain reusable from observations that have been invalidated.
forbidden_result: Reusable and invalidated observations are treated as the same category.
Invalidated observations are presented as reusable.
obligations.observable_result: Observations are classified into reusable and invalidated categories.
obligations.state_after: Recommendation processing has separated reusable observations from invalidated observations.
obligations.state_before: The current snapshot contains observations requiring classification.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev observation classifier
obligations.trigger: After reading the explicit current snapshot and before producing recommendations.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not run tests during recommendation-only processing.

obligations.state_before: Quick Dev recommendation-only processing is invoked.
obligations.subject: Quick Dev test execution

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not create a run during recommendation-only processing.
